rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a household understood as a family or home unit.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaa1 ting4 jau5 sei3 go3 jan4

rows.note: Use this colloquial form when you mean the people who live in the home, rather than the unit itself.

example.english: Everyone in my household supports me.
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jan4 dou1 zi1 ci4 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for the work and chores involved in running a home.

example.english: I do household chores as soon as I get home.
example.traditional: 我放工返屋企就做家務。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gung1 faan1 uk1 kei2 zau6 zou6 gaa1 mou6

rows.note: Use this for an official or demographic household unit, especially when referring to its occupants.

example.english: Every household has to fill in this form.
example.traditional: 每個住戶都要填呢份表格。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 zyu6 wu6 dou1 jiu3 tin4 ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3
